I am an old man now, 86 years, and I have farmed this land my whole life here in Ntchisi. This small plot near the house is where I grow my maize for eating, and though my family has other land, my hands are not as strong as before, so my sons and grandchildren help me. I will buy a little fertilizer from the ADMARC if the subsidy coupon reaches me, but the price is high and I cannot afford much, so I stretch it with the manure from my goats and chickens. I plant the hybrid seed the extension man brought some seasons back because it gives more cobs, but I do not spray chemicals or irrigate — we wait for the rains as we always have.
